questions.question: What does Mahito look like?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is a human-looking cursed spirit with a patchwork face and gray eyes.

questions.question: What does the anime show about Mahito's eyes?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: In the anime, Mahito possesses heterochromia, as his left eye is dark blue and his right eye is gray.

questions.question: What does Mahito's hair look like?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He has long grayish-blue hair that reaches past his neck and is sectioned off into three large strands with ties at the ends.

questions.question: What does Mahito normally wear?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito normally sports a black shawl that is separated into three pieces on the left sleeve.

questions.question: What does Mahito wear besides his black shawl?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He also wears matching pants with and sometimes without white shoes.

questions.question: How does Mahito's power compare to Sukuna's fingers?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit that eclipses the power of at least three of Sukuna's fingers at the time of his first encounter with Yuji Itadori, and only continues to grow stronger.

questions.question: How does Mahito compare to Jogo in age and experience?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He is younger than Jogo and as a result, is less experienced and not as powerful at first.

questions.question: What is notable about Mahito's growth as a special grade cursed spirit?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Despite this, Mahito is far above what a special grade cursed spirit would normally be and demonstrates rapid growth over the course of only two months.

questions.question: What is notable about Mahito's development potential?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito has incredible development potential, as on multiple instances he has developed in the middle of battle.

questions.question: How did Mahito fare in his one-on-one fight with Kento Nanami?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: In a one on one fight, he was able to overwhelm the grade 1 sorcerer, Kento Nanami, by rendering his cursed technique useless.

questions.question: What did Nanami believe after his fight with Mahito?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Following that fight, Nanami believed that Mahito had to be exorcised immediately or else he would grow into something too fearsome for Jujutsu High to handle.

questions.question: What would likely have happened in Mahito's two-on-one battle with Nanami and Yuji?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: In Mahito's two on one battle with Nanami and Yuji, Mahito would have likely defeated both jujutsu sorcerers if it were not for Sukuna's intervention.

questions.question: What did Mahito manage to do during his fight with Nanami and Yuji?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: During this fight, Mahito was able to grow stronger while his life was in danger, allowing him to conjure his own Domain Expansion.

questions.question: What new abilities did Mahito develop during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Later, during the Shibuya Incident, Mahito went further beyond his boundaries, being able to create clones of himself that were indistinguishable from the original, while also developing his soul-manipulating abilities.

questions.question: What did Mahito do during his fight with Yuji and Aoi Todo that increased his power?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: During his fight with Yuji and later, Aoi Todo, he managed to land a Black Flash on the two of them, allowing him to gain sufficient understanding of cursed energy and his own soul to activate Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing, further increasing his power.

questions.question: How strong is Mahito?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito has great physical strength.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Mahito do to Yuji in their second fight?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He mercilessly beat Yuji in their second fight, enough to make the latter cough up blood.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Mahito claim he could have done to Yuji?
questions.subject: Mahito

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How did Mahito's strength fare against Mechamarus and Nanami?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He could easily destroy numerous Mechamarus and was strong enough to pin down Nanami.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How powerful are Mahito's hits when enhanced with Black Flash?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: When enhanced with Black Flash, Mahito's hits can be so powerful they made Aoi Todo cough up blood despite the latter focusing his cursed energy to protect the impacted area.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How fast is Mahito?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito has immense speed.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How did Mahito blitz past Nanami's guard?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He was able to blitz past Nanami's guard in their fight by morphing his legs.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: Who was Mahito able to outrun?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He was able to outrun Yuji and attack Todo so fast the only thing he could do was to focus his cursed energy to protect himself.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How are Mahito's reflexes?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito has superb reflexes.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Mahito do while fighting Yuji and Todo?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: When fighting with Yuji and Todo, he was able to react to their attacks and counter.

questions.question: How did Mahito handle Todo's Boogie Woogie?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito even kept up with Todo's Boogie Woogie to an extent.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Mahito do while fighting both Yuji and Nanami?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He even single-handedly fought both Yuji and Nanami, all while dodging their attacks and countering extremely fast.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How difficult is Mahito to kill?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is exceptionally difficult to kill.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How do physical attacks fare against Mahito?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Not only does his cursed technique render physical attacks meaningless, but even Mahito's soul is extremely resistant to damage.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Nanami attempt to do to Mahito's body during their battle?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Nanami attempted to crush Mahito's body, but he went through their entire battle without expressing that he felt any pain even when attacks did land.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Mahito do when Yuji hit his soul and both sorcerers overwhelmed him?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: When Yuji was able to hit Mahito's soul and both jujutsu sorcerers overwhelmed Mahito, he was able to weather the storm and unlocked a new power instead of allowing his body to crumble under the pressure.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What damage did Mahito suffer from Yuji's reinforced punches while using a weakened Instant Spirit Body?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: While using Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing in a weakened state, Mahito suffered zero damage from Yuji's reinforced punches.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: What did Yuji believe could take Mahito down?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: This prompted Yuji to believe that only a Black Flash imbued with his maximum cursed energy could take Mahito down.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Physical Prowess

questions.question: How intelligent is Mahito?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito possesses very high intellectual prowess, especially for a cursed spirit.

questions.question: How did Mahito deal with the jujutsu sorcerers investigating him?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He was accurately able to deduce that jujutsu sorcerers were investigating him and was able to set a trap for his pursuers.

questions.question: What can Mahito surmise about an opponent after a few exchanges?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito can also surmise his opponent's skill level and even their cursed technique after just a few exchanges.

questions.question: What did Mahito realize about Nanami and Yuji?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He was able to accurately do so against Nanami and he was able to realize that Yuji had the ability to see souls thanks to his relationship with Sukuna.

questions.question: How does Mahito compare to Hanami in developing countermeasures to Boogie Woogie?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: He developed countermeasures to Todo's Boogie Woogie far quicker than Hanami did.

questions.question: What role does Mahito play in his faction's operations?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Along with Kenjaku, Mahito often acts as the brains of his faction's operation.

questions.question: How much cursed energy does Mahito have at his disposal?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito has a vast amount of cursed energy at his disposal.

questions.question: What did Nanami say about fighting Mahito until his cursed energy ran out?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Nanami himself said that fighting Mahito until his cursed energy ran out was unrealistic.

questions.question: What was Mahito capable of doing during the Shibuya Incident without exhausting his cursed energy?
questions.subject: Mahito

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Energy

questions.question: What could Mahito still do after separating half of his remaining cursed energy into a clone?
questions.subject: Mahito

questions.question: How did Mahito evolve his control over cursed energy?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: As the events progressed, Mahito evolved his control over cursed energy.

questions.subject: Mahito

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Energy

questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito's cursed technique grants him the ability to reshape souls.

questions.question: What can Mahito do by reshaping souls?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Doing so allows him to disfigure the body of his victims, heal his own wounds, transform his appendages into weapons, and a variety of other possible transformations.

questions.question: What can Mahito create that may use Idle Transfiguration on itself?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito can even create a clone that may use Idle Transfiguration on himself but not on others.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is Soul Multiplicity?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito uses his cursed technique to merge two or more souls together, which causes a reaction due to the rejection of the merge.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is Body Repel?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: By using the effect of Soul Multiplicity and increasing the energy of the souls, Mahito directs the overwhelming output of their rejection towards an opponent.

questions.question: Why is a Polymorphic Soul Isomer more stable than a regular transfigured human?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: A Polymorphic Soul Isomer is more stable than a regular transfigured human, as it doesn't seem to be capable of randomly dying mid-battle.

questions.question: What gives a Polymorphic Soul Isomer's attacks their explosive power?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: A result of expending so many souls at once is the explosive power behind the Isomer's attacks, as they're strong enough to send a powerful sorcerer, like Aoi Todo, flying.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is the trade-off of a Polymorphic Soul Isomer?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: However, the trade-off is the low durability of these transfigured humans, which was shown when Todo managed to take them down in just one punch for each.

questions.question: What is Mahito's Curtain barrier capable of?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: The barrier is capable of sealing the area off from other people or a specific person wanting to get in.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: What is Mahito's Domain Expansion called, and what does it do?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Self-Embodiment of Perfection 自閉円頓裹 Jihei Endonka: Mahito's Domain Expansion creates an environment where he is automatically connected with the souls of anyone inside and is capable of transfiguring them at will.

questions.note: prose: Abilities and Powers / Cursed Technique

questions.question: How flexibly can Mahito control his Domain Expansion?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: His control over the technique is flexible enough that, much like Satoru Gojo, he is capable of activating it for 0.2 second intervals.

questions.question: What does Mahito's name translate to?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito's name rather ironically translates to "true person" 真人 masato, tying into his group's ideology of curses being the "true humans".

questions.question: What does Junpei Yoshino catch himself saying when Mahito attacks Yuji Itadori?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Junpei Yoshino even catches himself mid-sentence when Mahito attacks Yuji Itadori, saying "Mahito's not a bad person", only then realizing the truth about his evil mentor.

questions.question: What does Mahito's name reference from Daoism?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito's name also plays heavily into Daoism as it goes off of the title of "Zhenren" 真人, literally meaning a "true or perfect person", referring to sages who have aligned themselves with the Dao.

questions.question: What Daoist term do the first two characters of Mahito's cursed technique reference?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: This is also consistent as his Cursed Technique "Idle Transfiguration", specifically its first two characters "Mui" 無為, is the Daoist term of Wuwei" 無為, the method of doing an action without overthinking it by aligning oneself with the Dao.

questions.question: Which mangaka considers Mahito his favorite Jujutsu Kaisen character?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is the favorite Jujutsu Kaisen character of Kohei Horikoshi, the author of My Hero Academia, which coincidentally features two antagonists that are similar to Mahito (Tomura Shigaraki and Dabi).

questions.question: Which manga volume covers does Mahito appear on individually?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito is one of the four characters who appeared individually on two separate manga volume covers, his being Volume 6 and Volume 15.

questions.question: What was Mahito born from?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: Mahito was born from humanity's collective hatred and fear of other humans.

questions.question: What makes Mahito unique among the members of his group?
questions.subject: Mahito

answer.item: This makes him the only member of the group to not be born from a fear of natural disasters.
